title: Smiling Young Girl Playing Dress-Up Outdoors, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming full-length vintage snapshot of a cheerful young girl playing dress-up outdoors. She wears an oversized, ankle-length light dress or nightgown and a dark novelty or military-style cap with a patterned crest/band tilted on her head. Smiling warmly with her hands clasped in front of her, she stands in an unpaved, rocky yard with foliage and the wooden corner of a residential building in the background.
